title: F2F: building blocks for your agent
description: F2F is how your agent finds ready building blocks through Lagrix — and buys them without a middleman.

blocks.text: F2F is the protocol your agent uses to find building blocks for itself: booking, a client base, a night assistant or any other ready element made by another Fractera project.

The search is the same as in A2A, with a much larger set of technical details: template version, API doors, languages, licence, the seller's rating. Your agent picks the block that fits, agrees on the price and pays through escrow — and you simply get a new capability.
